description: Checks the arithmetic of one US auto repair quote or estimate from the amounts read on it: the communicated total and the itemized lines (parts, labor, fees, tax, credits, refundable core charges). Returns the result of the repairworth.com engine unchanged: `basis` (communicated-total, complete-known-breakdown or partial-known-breakdown), the total the quote supports (`displayLowCents`, `displayHighCents`), the sum of the known lines, the lines with no amount (`unknown`), the refundable amounts, and `reconciliation`, the gap between the communicated total and the itemized lines, given only when every line is known. Amounts come back in integer US cents. The tool holds no market price and no typical range: it does not say what the work should cost or whether a price is fair. An input the engine refuses comes back with `valid: false` and the engine's own messages.

lines.description: Itemized lines of the quote: parts, labor, fees, tax, credits, refundable charges.

conditionalRefund.description: true for an amount refunded only if a condition is met, such as a core charge returned with the old part. It stays out of the total and is reported in the refund fields.

high.description: Upper bound of the line (range only). US dollars with at most two decimals: a number, or a string such as "85", "85.50" or "$1,234.50".

key.description: Stable identifier of the line, such as "parts" or "labor". compare_quotes matches the lines of two quotes by this key. Default: "line-<index>".

label.description: Name of the line as it should appear in messages. Default: "Line <n>".

low.description: Amount of the line, or its lower bound. Never negative: a credit is a positive amount with `sign: -1`. US dollars with at most two decimals: a number, or a string such as "85", "85.50" or "$1,234.50".

mode.description: fixed: one amount in `low`. range: `low` to `high`. unknown: the quote gives no amount for this line. included: covered by another line or by the total. not-applicable: the line does not exist on this quote. Only fixed and range carry an amount; the three others are never counted as zero.

sign.description: -1 for a credit or discount, which is subtracted from the known lines.

totalHigh.description: Upper bound of the communicated total (range only). US dollars with at most two decimals: a number, or a string such as "85", "85.50" or "$1,234.50".

totalLow.description: Communicated total, or its lower bound. US dollars with at most two decimals: a number, or a string such as "85", "85.50" or "$1,234.50".

totalMode.description: Status of the total written on the quote. fixed: one amount in `totalLow`. range: `totalLow` to `totalHigh`. unknown, included or not-applicable: no total was communicated, and the known lines are summed instead.

name: analyze_quote
title: Analyze a Repair Quote
